name: The tool you need depends on the thing that broke
summary: A change acts on a core system that a status, control or recovery tool depends on, with no practised independent route to that tool, and it hits the whole system at once: when it breaks, the tool you need to see or fix it breaks too.
safe_pattern: Give status, control and recovery tools an independent, practised fallback that doesn't depend on the systems they help recover, before changing those systems.

conditions.text: The change acts on a core system

citations.quote: one of the inputs to the command was entered incorrectly and a larger set of servers was removed than intended.

conditions.text: A status, control or recovery tool depends on that system

citations.quote: we were unable to update the individual services' status on the AWS Service Health Dashboard (SHD) because of a dependency the SHD administration console has on Amazon S3.
Our customers were unable to access the Cloudflare Dashboard or API because they pass through the Cloudflare edge.

conditions.text: No independent fallback is recorded for that tool

citations.quote: we have changed the SHD administration console to run across multiple AWS regions.
citations.note: remediation step; implies the console had no independent route before

citations.quote: we had to use a bypass mechanism that wasn't frequently used
citations.note: a bypass existed but wasn't practised
